summary.name: Python Bytes Podcast
summary.one_liner: Python Bytes is a weekly podcast delivering Python developer news, tools, and tips, hosted by Michael Kennedy and Calvin Hendryx-Parker.
use_cases: find new Python tools and libraries
read show notes with links to Python articles
subscribe to a Python news feed on a phone
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Python Bytes as a weekly podcast with Python news, tools, and tips, hosted by Michael Kennedy and Calvin Hendryx-Parker. Each episode contains a set of news items; the latest listed episode (#502, October 27, 2026) covers topics such as chameleon-rs, uv and ty, and stlite. Every episode comes with full show notes and links. The page also mentions a weekly email newsletter with each episode's links and a sister interview show, Talk Python To Me. Listeners can submit items for consideration by email.
notable: Weekly show with 502 episodes and 3.5M+ words of show notes and spoken content
Full show notes and links for every item
Sister show Talk Python To Me for long-form interviews
caveats: Platform support beyond the web is implied by a one-tap app subscription line, not detailed on the page
Pricing is not stated; the page does not mention paid tiers
